mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, we have clear skies near Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 72 degrees and a moderate air quality index of 52.

The Verona Common Council recently voted unanimously to adopt the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-term strategy focuses on creating diverse housing, supporting our local manufacturing and technology hub, and fostering a vibrant downtown experience.

We have a busy day ahead for our community! Today you can catch the Puppets in the Park festival at Century School Park or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, yoga classes return this Sunday and trivia nights kick off at local breweries starting Monday.

In our weekly police report, we noted an incident from October 3 where an officer located a 19-year-old driving with expired registration. The individual was arrested for a stolen firearm charge and a probation warrant.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for our flavor of the day, Raspberry Cheesecake. We are currently open and will be serving up treats until 10:30 PM tonight.
